title: 요금업종별요율표 — Rate table by category
archive_note: Text of the page. All rate tables machine-readable in the source. Statutory bases named on the page: Article 23 of the Seoul Water Supply Ordinance and Article 23 of the Seoul Sewerage Use Ordinance.
establishes: Basic charge by meter bore: 1,080 won a month at 15 mm, 3,000 at 20 mm, 5,200 at 25 mm
Domestic water usage: 580 won per m3, a single rate with no bands, under Article 23 of the Seoul Water Supply Ordinance
Domestic sewerage for 2026: 480 won per m3, single rate, with a published schedule rising to 560, 630, 700 and 770 through 2030
The water-use burden levy: 170 won per m3, universal across categories, in force since 1 January 2011 — mandatory and volumetric
The complete set of what Arisu bills a domestic customer: basic charge, usage charge, sewerage charge and levy
does_not_establish: The tax treatment. No tax line appears in the table, and that is not evidence of exemption — Tokyo's rate table carries no tax line either while its calculation formula multiplies by 1.10. Needs Arisu's calculation page or the Value Added Tax Act exemption provision.
The reference connection. The table prices eight bores from 15 mm up and does not say which is ordinary for a single dwelling. §2.5 bars Grade A until a primary designation is found.
Whether the reference account is separately metered. Arisu's moving-settlement page shows apartments on shared meters with the basic charge apportioned, which is a different reference customer.
internal_inconsistency_noted: The prose beneath the water table says all four categories use a three-band progressive structure; the table shows domestic as a single rate and dates itself to 1 July 2021. The prose describes the superseded structure. The table governs.
